prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1151; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative. On arrival at the intersection, I observed a two-vehicle collision involving a side impact. Driver 1 was operating a silver sedan eastbound and stated that the signal was green for their direction of travel. Driver 2 was operating a white pickup truck southbound and stated that they entered the intersection on a yellow light. The front driver's side of the pickup struck the passenger side of the sedan. A Passenger was seated in the front right seat of the sedan. Driver 1 reported pain in the left wrist and was evaluated on scene by EMS, then transported by ambulance for further treatment. Both vehicles sustained heavy damage and were towed from the scene. Skid marks were noted on the southbound approach. Traffic control was established by responding units until the roadway was cleared.
